preRestore.name: Add v2ray static User
preRestore.command: systemctl stop v2ray; addgroup v2ray; adduser --system --no-create-home --ingroup v2ray v2ray

preRestore.name: Create directories for logs and set owner

postRestore.name: Restart and enable v2ray
postRestore.command: systemctl enable --now v2ray.service; systemctl restart v2ray.service
